title: Help cards
description: profiles/<slug>/tickets/<id>/help.json: the ticket's 'Help me understand' answers, a JSON array of HelpCard (src/chat/explain.ts), oldest first, the last 50. Written by Helper.ask in src/chat/explain.ts (re-read, append, pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomic temp+rename). A file that isn't an array reads as []. Unknown fields must be kept.

id.description: h_ + base36 time + up to 4 random base36 chars.

kind.description: HelpKind: recap ('What happened while I was away?') or changes ('Explain the changes').

model.description: Model the side call reported (asked for sonnet).
